def knapsack(weight, value, maxWeight):
    dp = [0] * (maxWeight + 1)
    for i in range(len(value)):
        for j in range(maxWeight, weight[i] - 1, -1):
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], value[i] + dp[j - weight[i]])

def kadanesAlgorithm(arr):
